assistant_text: These results are from a prior run and may not reflect recent changes to the decision model. Treat any figures below as directional rather than definitive. The London hire option leads in roughly 62% of simulations, driven primarily by deeper domain expertise (~£12K/month higher revenue capture) offset by a longer onboarding ramp.
